title: Marta's family profile
text: Esta es Marta. Esta es su familia. Su madre se llama Ana. Su padre se llama Luis. Marta tiene una hermana. Su hermana se llama Elena.
native_translation: This is Marta. This is her family. Her mother is named Ana. Her father is named Luis. Marta has a sister. Her sister is named Elena.

title: Sibling note
text: Pablo tiene un hermano. Su hermano se llama Diego. Elena no tiene hermanos.
native_translation: Pablo has a brother. His brother is named Diego. Elena does not have siblings.

title: A simple home
text: Esta es la casa de Ana. La cocina está aquí. El salón está allí. El dormitorio está a la derecha.
native_translation: This is Ana's home. The kitchen is here. The living room is there. The bedroom is on the right.

title: Objects at home
text: Hay una mesa en la cocina. La silla está al lado de la mesa. La cama está en el dormitorio.
native_translation: There is a table in the kitchen. The chair is next to the table. The bed is in the bedroom.

title: Where family members are
text: Mi madre está en el salón. Mi padre está en la cocina. Mi hermana está en el dormitorio.
native_translation: My mother is in the living room. My father is in the kitchen. My sister is in the bedroom.

title: Short family and home profile
text: Me llamo Carlos. Vivo en un piso. Mi familia vive aquí. Tengo una hermana. Se llama Sofia. En mi casa hay una mesa y una silla.
native_translation: My name is Carlos. I live in an apartment. My family lives here. I have a sister. Her name is Sofia. In my home there is a table and a chair.
